thread:
oncall-bot: ALERT: p99 decode latency spike detected in us-west-2 cluster (service: runtime/gpu-serving). Automated mitigation policies engaged.

oncall-bot: Incident ID INC-236789 - paging symptoms + streaming stalls observed. Paging rate up 6x in last 10m.

alex.chen: seeing the same in metrics. p95 up from 120ms -> 420ms, p99 from 480ms -> 2.1s. Streaming sessions show stalled chunks, kv-cache fill rate drops.

maria_g: stack trace-ish from one example host:
```
E decode_loop: kernel_launch failed: CUDA_ERROR_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT
... compilepath: /opt/runtime/bin/compilepipe -flag fast-math -opt-level 3
```

ben_ops: noticed a deploy about 30m ago: TRT runtime bump + new compile flags pushed to kernel builds (flag: --enable-async-kernel). Could be related.

alex.chen: confirming deploy-bot: `deploy-bot: rollout trt-runtime-v8.2 -> us-west-2 (canary 10% -> 100% 00:28 ago)`

maria_g: quick triage checklist: 1) Isolate affected pool 2) Check paging I/O saturation 3) Revert compile flags if correlated 4) Enable secondary fallback model variant to avoid decode stalls.

sre-rotation: I've spun up extra reserved nodes in us-west-2 and pinned traffic away from the most impacted hosts via routing rule `route:avoid-high-paging`. p99 dropped ~20% but still elevated.

ben_ops: i'm running a live grep on the build artifacts to see which kernels include the new flag: `grep -R "enable-async-kernel" /artifacts/trt/*`

alex.chen: local repro on a small batch shows repeated tail retries causing queue build-up. When we force fallback to quantized-compat variant (model suffix -q4), downstream latency recovers to p99 ~ 520ms. That's a workable mitigation.

maria_g: ok push an immediate routing fallback: set per-tenant policy to prefer -q4 variant for latency-sensitive customers. Also roll back the compile flag in the kernel build pipeline if we can patch quickly.

ben_ops: preparing rollback. patch command to remove flag in CI:
```
ci/patches/remove-async-kernel.patch
- compile_flags += ["--enable-async-kernel"]
+ # removed async kernel flag due to paging regression
```

ben_ops: starting rollback to trt-runtime-v8.1 on the most impacted hosts (30 nodes). Will stream progress.

alex.chen: heads-up to customer-facing teams: some PLG customers may see degraded streaming responsiveness for 15-30m. Maria, can you draft a quick blurb?

maria_g: @support-team draft: "We're investigating an elevated latency event impacting streaming and tail decode in us-west-2. We have active mitigations (fallback model routing and a runtime rollback) and expect improvement within the hour. We'll post updates." :loud_sound:

oncall-bot: Paging summary: affected region us-west-2, symptom: p99 decode up to 2.1s, root suspected: compile flag + TRT runtime bump, mitigations: fallback model routing, runtime rollback, add capacity.

ben_ops: rollback progress: 10/30 hosts reverted, p99 trending down to 1.2s in the affected pool. continuing.

alex.chen: added a guard in the serving runtime to detect high pagerate + launch failures and auto-shed non-critical batched requests. This reduces kv-cache thrash. patch applied to one canary host.

maria_g: ops update: 20/30 hosts reverted. Support blurb updated: now "improvements observed; some customers may experience brief reconnections."

ben_ops: rollback done on 30/30. p95 back to ~150ms, p99 at ~350ms. Still above baseline but much better.

alex.chen: follow-ups: 1) root cause postmortem - correlate compile flags, TRT commit, and kernel launch telemetry; 2) add automatic rollback trait to rollout orchestration when p99 > 1s for >10m; 3) more robust streaming retry/backoff to avoid queue storms.

maria_g: scheduling a 30m handoff to eng-runtime and platform for deep triage. Please include build and deploy owners.

oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled: thread INC-236789 -> eng-runtime (sre-rotation) + eng-platform (ben_ops) at ts 2367890350.
